name: Katsuki Daiki
source:
A detective in the “Special Division for Anomalous Crimes,” assigned to cases steeped in the mysterious and inexplicable. He may appear carefree, but his deep knowledge and quiet empathy drive him to pursue truth for the victims’ sake. Haunted by past trauma, he refuses to embrace modern technology, relying instead on an outdated ARI device with only the most basic functions. 

[From [url=https://duskindexgion.bushiroadgames.com/en/#character]Official English website[/url]]
